blocks.text: SWIFT FIRE FROM HEAVEN WILL DESCEND— Scientists with a watchful eye — right above the heads of the population of the earth. God’s poised and awesome power beyond atomic! Atomic-Hydrogen — ‘‘The great asteroids created ahead of time for God’s judgment to come!’’ — Energy to wipe out hundreds of millions or more (Matt. 24:22) Enough force to draw the tides of the ocean to cover the cities! — ‘‘In my opinion they are scheduled for this century!’’ — This planet will be scarred and changed like never before! (Rev. 8:10 — Rev. 6:12 — Isa. chap. 24) — “Tn a short period of time from now this planet will be no place to live!’ — It will be breaking up, tidal waves and winds moving 700 to a thousand miles per hour! — Horror and Terror! — ‘‘Rejection of the Lord Jesus, and as the population turns to idol worship and imaging will bring this terrifying holocaust and judgment!’’

COSMIC FORCES COMING— On the front of Newsweek Mag. (Nov. 23, 1992) — It spoke about Comets, Asteroids and how the world might end, and called it doomsday according to science!’’ — It told of an asteroid barely missing the earth in 1989. A NASA spokeman said, ‘‘sooner or later, our planet will be struck by one.’’ — Scientists say if something 6 miles across hits the ground it would have an explosive force of 100 million megatons of TNT and level everything within hundreds of miles! “According to prophecy, even larger ones than this will strike!’’ — Also Jesus said, ‘‘great signs and fearful sights shall there be from the heaven!”’ (Luke 21:11) — Note: Other newspaper and magazine articles said that an asteroid or asteroids will devastate the earth! ‘‘Some even say in the near future!’’ It seems the cares of life has hidden this from most on this earth. — ‘‘But it shall take place, saith the Lord. The wise should prepare their hearts, for I am coming!”

CONTINUING— THE FUTURE UNVEILED — An old but yet a new weapon overlooked. Science discovers what the Bible says, and what the Scripts predicted over 25 years ago! ‘‘God’s creation weapons in space, plus the weather and nature He will use as the age ends!’’ Space is filled with objects that threaten earth. — Researchers are scrambling to ensure that these cosmic collisions do not collide with earth, but according to prophecy they will not be able to prevent it. — To the world horror, ‘‘but to the elect comforting, knowing that Jesus is coming!’’

PROPHECY— Not fantasy, but real facts — The Scriptures don’t give an exact date, but this is exactly what they have to say for our generation! (Matt. 24:33) — “‘It is my definite opinion this decade will not escape the impact these great junks of fire (some even mountain size or larger) will have! We now will add these confirming Scriptures. Rev. 8:7-11 — The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up. And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood; And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and the third part of the ships were destroyed. And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters; And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter. — Rev. 6:13-17, And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely Sigs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind. And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places. And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains; And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

MYSTERIOUS CATASTROPHIC EVENT— 1908 — We quote: In rare instances, a meteor of enormous size has been swept into the earth’s gravitational field and appeared as a flaming horror, striking the earth with a tremendous impact. On the morning of June 30, 1908, a great meteor blazed over Siberia and crashed to the earth in an isolated region. Only this fact that it fell in a wildemess prevented its doing incalculable damage. As it was, about 25,000 acres of forest were left a smoking ruin. For distances of 25 miles in all directions, trees were blown flat to the ground. Accompanying the explosion, a pillar of smoke rose for a distance of 15 miles. Five hundred miles away, an engineer stopped his train lest it be derailed. Had the meteorite hit five hours later allowing the earth to rotate eastward, it would have struck in the vicinity of St. Petersburg (now Leningrad), and the lives of millions of people in that area where the Russian Revolution was to occur a few years later would have been snuffed out. — Evidently this asteroid war of atomic particles from outer space, was fiery and exploded just before impact.

FROM ASTRONOMY MAGAZINE— September 1991 — We Quote — What would happen if an Earth crosser like 1989 FC actually struck Earth? John O’Keefe and Thomas Ahrens at Caltech have run computer models using asteroid 1989 FC traveling at 11 kilometers per second (24,500 miles per hour) relative to Earth, twice as fast as a speeding bullet. Their models show that the asteroid passes through the lower atmosphere in less than a second, not enough time for anyone in its path to see it coming. A shockwave is then driven into the ground and into the asteroid. The result: the asteroid is mostly vaporized, changing from solid to liquid to gas in a fraction of a second. The explosion generates the energy equivalent of a 1,000 megaton bomb explosion and temperatures of 20,000° C. Hot gas from the vaporized object shoots into the sky and drags more air with it. A shockwave spreads away from the impact and everything within a hundred kilometers is set on fire from the heat of the blast. About 500 kilometers away the temperature is still a scalding 100° C. The blast travels outward at 35,000 kilometers per hour and levels everything for 250 kilometers. Material from the impact rains down, mostly in the form of molten droplets of rock. A crater about ten times the diameter of the impactor is left behind. Asteroid 1989 FC has wiped out a city the size of New York in an instant. Calculating the death and devastation from the impact of even a small asteroid staggers the mind. Given a range of uncertainty which can only be narrowed by experiments (avoidable ones,

we hope) scientists at a 1981 conference on mass extinctions calculated that a collision with a 200-meter-diameter asteroid would produce a 1,000-megaton explosion and between 200,000 and 100 million deaths.
Collision with a 400-meter-diameter object would produce a 10,000-megaton blast and between two million and one billion fatalities.
And that is from an asteroid less than half a kilometer across. Note: At times, God will rain down upon the earth large fireballs.

THE GOSPEL TRUTH— Quote — N.W. Hutchings — The heavenly bodies have a story to tell. They are witnesses providing us with knowledge concerning God’s eternal will and purpose. Of the creation of the heavens, we read in Genesis 1:14, ‘‘And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years.’’ This scripture is in perfect accord with the science of astronomy. The rotation of the earth determines our days, the orbit of the earth around the sun determines our years, and the tilting of the earth on its axis determines our seasons. Not only is this in harmony with Scripture, but the Word of God states that all planets, moons, stars, galaxies, and clusters are for signs. There is not a planet, moon, asteroid, or comet that does not have its own place in the universal blueprint designed by the Creator. The word for ‘“‘signs,”’ as found in Genesis 1:14, is oth in the Hebrew. A sign is a mark to indicate something greater than the mark itself. Musical notes are symbols, or signs, to a pianist sitting at his instrument. If the pianist interprets the notes together in proper sequence, then the audience hears what the creator of the music intended when he wrote the composition. Likewise, the heavens are signs, as notes on a sheet of music. If we interpret the signs in the heavens correctly, then we can understand and appreciate the symphony of God’s creation from the beginning to the end. Signs in the heavens can also be compared to notes of music in another way. As the pianist plays a sonata, the music, like a constant revelation, is heard in its proper sequence. Similarly, ‘‘signs’’ in Genesis 1:14 means that the heavens are the unfurling of God’s revelation to man. In other words, the heavens tell the story of things to come.
Note: Jesus said, Pray that ye escape all of these things and the elect will and stand before the living God. ‘‘Even so come Lord Jesus!’’
